source.title: The clutch, understood. — Hilliard Inferno Flame trackside service guide
source.assumption: Confirm cover name + bronze bushing vs needle bearing before service; lubrication differs.

baseline.note: Hilliard suggested initial contact with 2 white + 2 black springs, opposite matching colors, four leading shoes, no optional weights. Initial contact ≠ full lock-up.
baseline.spring_rule: Heavier/stronger spring → later bite. Weaker → earlier. Match opposite springs. Mixed colors = intermediate.

rpm_speed_read.purpose: Use engine RPM and kart speed TOGETHER to diagnose early vs late slip. Never use RPM alone.

phases.idle: Shoes in; drum free. Speed ~0; RPM at idle below engagement.
phases.initial_contact: Centrifugal force overcomes springs; shoes first touch drum.
phases.controlled_slip: RPM rising while speed lags — shoes rubbing while speeds equalize. Short slip normal on launch.
phases.lock: RPM and road speed rise together (nearly 1:1 after gearing). Prolonged high RPM after speed catches up = incomplete lock.

signatures.name: Engages too late / slides too long
signatures.telemetry: RPM flares (climbs hard) while speed lags / rises slowly after throttle; optionally large RPM–speed divergence after launch or hairpin exits.
setup_actions: Stop and cool; inspect oil/chain-lube contamination, glaze, blocked shoe grooves, heat damage.
Confirm shoes slide freely; springs not wrongly installed or excessively strong.
Check chain alignment/slack, brake drag, gearing (tall ratio can demand more clutch torque than setup can give).
If hardware healthy: lower engagement with weaker OEM springs OR add Hilliard weights symmetrically; prefer leading shoe orientation for firmer bite.
signatures.health_ui_line: Late slip: RPM up, speed lagging — clutch converting power to heat. Cool → clean → then softer springs or more weight (balanced).

signatures.name: Engages too early / harsh early grab
signatures.telemetry: RPM drops sharply as clutch bites while speed is still low; or engagement begins below intended RPM; kart may bog / load the engine.
confirm_also: engine loads when braking to a stop
setup_actions: Verify idle below engagement and throttle returns fully.
Drum/driver freewheels with engine off; no rub on cover/spacers/guard.
Inspect seized/dry bearing, wrong stack-up, grease drag, broken springs, shoes hanging on lugs.
If mechanically sound: raise engagement with stronger OEM springs; remove optional weights in balanced pairs.
signatures.health_ui_line: Early bite: RPM falls hard as it grabs — raise engagement (stronger springs / remove weights) after ruling out drag.

signatures.name: Never fully locks
signatures.telemetry: After speed has caught up, RPM stays high / keeps flaring under load — clutch not achieving full lock.
setup_actions: Inspect contamination, glaze, worn shoes/drum, weak torque capacity (springs/weights/orientation).
signatures.health_ui_line: Incomplete lock: speed caught up but RPM still high — stop, inspect friction surfaces.

signatures.name: Bog with low RPM (not classic slip)
signatures.telemetry: RPM stays low AND kart acceleration is poor (no flare).
setup_actions: Investigate engine/throttle opening, brake drag, gearing, excess load BEFORE blaming clutch.
signatures.health_ui_line: Low RPM + sluggish speed = power/drag/gear first — not a slip-flare clutch call.

spring_direction_cheat.more_shoe_weight: Earlier bite + more torque capacity (~100–200 rpm lower per insert, opposite shoes identical)

shop_checklist_plain: RPM flares, speed lags → slipping late/too much: cool → clean shoes/drum → then weaker springs or add balanced weights (leading shoes for firmer lock).
RPM drops hard / boggy early grab → gripping too early: stronger springs; remove balanced weights; confirm idle below engagement.
Heavier/stronger springs = later engagement; lighter/weaker = earlier.
Always match opposite shoes (spring color, weights, leading/trailing). Never reuse weight snap rings.
Needle bearing ≠ bronze bushing: grease only the needle kit lightly; bronze gets one drop light oil — never grease. Keep lube off friction faces.
Stop-now: drives at idle, cracked drum, broken spring, blue/purple smoked drum, seized bearing.
stop_now: Clutch drives kart at idle or will not release
Cracked drum, broken spring, missing retainer, loose mounting bolt
Blue/purple drum with smoke or persistent burnt smell
Needle bearing seized, gritty, or damaged
